name: roomwalk
description: Send it a link to the shop's website and it does the rest: reads what they make and how many photographs sit behind each category, proposes a scroll-driven walk through one generated room with their real work surfacing at each stop, then builds it. Ships the Higgsfield sign-in that Claude Code's own login cannot complete, the generation recipe, AVFoundation frame tools that need no ffmpeg, a seam measurer, and the scroll engine.
